mechanism: Cenobamate is a CYP3A4 inducer that may increase hydrocortisone metabolism, reducing corticosteroid efficacy; conversely, hydrocortisone may affect cenobamate levels through enzyme induction.
action: Monitor clinical response to hydrocortisone therapy and cenobamate seizure control; adjust hydrocortisone dosing if needed and consider therapeutic drug monitoring for cenobamate.
